title: Stackable Secret Operator
description: Values accepted by the operator Helm chart. The operator is a CSI driver and runs as two workloads: a controller Deployment and a node driver DaemonSet. Which credentials a workload receives is configured in SecretClass and TrustStore custom resources, not here.

image.title: Operator image

repository.title: Operator image registry and namespace
repository.description: Registry and namespace holding the operator image, without the image name. Set automatically when the chart is packaged, from the registry it is published to: oci.stackable.tech/sdp or quay.io/stackable/sdp.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Overrides the operator image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion, which is the SDP release.

pullPolicy.title: Image pull policy
pullPolicy.description: When to pull the operator image. Release tags are immutable, so IfNotPresent is enough. The CSI sidecars have their own pull policies.

pullSecrets.title: Image pull secrets
pullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull the operator image from a private registry. These apply to the secret-operator pods only, not to the pods that mount its volumes.

image.description: Where the operator image is pulled from and how. Used by both the controller Deployment and the node driver DaemonSet.

controllerService.title: Controller

podAnnotations.title: Pod annotations
podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the controller pod.

podSecurityContext.title: Pod security context
podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the controller pod, for example fsGroup. Passed through to Kubernetes unchanged.

nodeSelector.title: Node selector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels the controller pod must match to be scheduled.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.description: Affinity and anti-affinity rules for the controller pod.

priorityClassName.title: Priority class name
priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the controller pod. Unset means the cluster default.

resources.title: Resource requests and limits
resources.description: CPU and memory for the controller container.

securityContext.title: Container security context
securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the controller container. It runs as root because it manages secret material on disk.

controllerService.description: The controller Deployment. One replica cluster-wide, it reconciles SecretClass and TrustStore objects.

csiNodeDriver.title: CSI node driver

podAnnotations.title: Pod annotations
podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to the node driver pods.

podSecurityContext.title: Pod security context
podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the node driver pods, for example fsGroup. Passed through to Kubernetes unchanged.

nodeSelector.title: Node selector
nodeSelector.description: Node labels the node driver pods must match to be scheduled.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Taints the node driver pods tolerates.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.description: Affinity and anti-affinity rules for the node driver pods.

priorityClassName.title: Priority class name
priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for the node driver pods. Unset means the cluster default.

kubeletDir.title: Kubelet directory
kubeletDir.description: Root directory of the kubelet on each node, where the node driver registers its socket and finds the pod volume directories. The Kubernetes default is /var/lib/kubelet; distributions such as microk8s and k3s use a different path. See https://github.com/stackabletech/secret-operator/issues/229

nodeService.title: Node driver container

resources.title: Resource requests and limits
resources.description: CPU and memory for the operator's node driver container.

securityContext.title: Container security context
securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the node driver container. It runs as root because it writes secret material into pod volumes.

privileged.title: Run privileged
privileged.description: Whether the node driver container runs privileged. Privileged is strongly recommended: it lets the operator keep secret contents on a tmpfs that never reaches disk. Unprivileged mode is experimental and switching an existing cluster over needs a manual migration.

nodeService.description: The operator's own container in the node driver DaemonSet.

externalProvisioner.title: external-provisioner sidecar

image.title: external-provisioner image

repository.title: Registry and namespace
repository.description: Registry and namespace holding the sidecar image, without the image name. Defaults to image.repository with /sig-storage appended, so the csi-provisioner sidecar is pulled from the same registry as the operator.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Version of csi-provisioner to run. Pinned by the chart; change it only to match a mirror or to work around a specific upstream bug.

pullPolicy.title: Image pull policy
pullPolicy.description: When to pull the sidecar image.

image.description: Where the csi-provisioner sidecar image is pulled from and how.

resources.title: Resource requests and limits
resources.description: CPU and memory for the csi-provisioner sidecar.

externalProvisioner.description: The upstream csi-provisioner sidecar, which turns PersistentVolumeClaims into CSI provisioning calls.

nodeDriverRegistrar.title: node-driver-registrar sidecar

image.title: node-driver-registrar image

repository.title: Registry and namespace
repository.description: Registry and namespace holding the sidecar image, without the image name. Defaults to image.repository with /sig-storage appended, so the csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar is pulled from the same registry as the operator.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Version of csi-node-driver-registrar to run. Pinned by the chart; change it only to match a mirror or to work around a specific upstream bug.

pullPolicy.title: Image pull policy
pullPolicy.description: When to pull the sidecar image.

image.description: Where the csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar image is pulled from and how.

resources.title: Resource requests and limits
resources.description: CPU and memory for the csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar.

nodeDriverRegistrar.description: The upstream csi-node-driver-registrar sidecar, which registers the driver with the kubelet on each node.

csiNodeDriver.description: The node driver DaemonSet. One pod per node, it mounts secret volumes into the pods scheduled there.

nameOverride.title: Name override
nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name inside generated resource names. The release name is still prefixed. Installing release my-release with nameOverride=foo gives my-release-foo-daemonset instead of my-release-secret-operator-daemonset.

fullnameOverride.title: Full name override
fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the generated name entirely, including the release name prefix. Installing release my-release with fullnameOverride=bar gives bar-daemonset instead of my-release-secret-operator-daemonset.

serviceAccount.title: Service account

create.title: Create the service account
create.description: Whether the chart creates the ServiceAccount the operator runs as. Set to false to bring your own, then name it in serviceAccount.name. The ClusterRole and the ClusterRoleBinding that grants it are created by the chart either way, so an existing ServiceAccount still receives the operator's permissions.

annotations.title: Service account annotations
annotations.description: Annotations on the created ServiceAccount, for example an IAM role for IRSA or Workload Identity. Only applies when serviceAccount.create is true.

name.title: Service account name
name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount the operator pods run as. Leave empty to use the generated name, <release>-secret-operator-serviceaccount. Required when serviceAccount.create is false, where it tells the chart which existing ServiceAccount the workloads should run as and the ClusterRoleBinding should grant.

serviceAccount.description: Identity the operator pods run as. The chart binds it to the operator's ClusterRole, which is what grants permission to watch and manage its custom resources cluster-wide. Both the controller and the node driver use it.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels attached to every resource the chart deploys.

secretClasses.title: Built-in SecretClasses

tls.title: The tls SecretClass

caSecretNamespace.title: CA Secret namespace
caSecretNamespace.description: Namespace holding the Secret with the certificate authority that the built-in tls SecretClass issues from. Defaults to the namespace the operator is installed into.

tls.description: The tls SecretClass the operator creates on startup.

secretClasses.description: The SecretClasses the operator creates on startup, so a fresh cluster can issue certificates without any further setup.

kubernetesClusterDomain.title: Kubernetes cluster domain
kubernetesClusterDomain.description: Set this when the cluster does not use the default cluster.local domain. See https://docs.stackable.tech/home/stable/guides/kubernetes-cluster-domain

maintenance.title: Maintenance behaviour

endOfSupportCheck.title: End-of-support check
endOfSupportCheck.description: Warns when the running SDP release has reached end of support.

enabled.description: Whether the operator logs a warning once the running SDP release is out of support.

mode.title: Check mode
mode.description: Only offline is implemented: the check uses the release date compiled into the operator and makes no network calls.

interval.title: Check interval
interval.description: How often the check runs, as a duration such as 24h.

customResourceDefinitions.title: CustomResourceDefinitions

maintain.title: Let the operator manage its CRDs
maintain.description: The operator applies and updates its own CRDs at startup. Disable this only if CRDs are applied out of band, for example by a cluster admin with elevated rights.

customResourceDefinitions.description: How the operator handles its own CustomResourceDefinitions.

maintenance.description: Background housekeeping the operator performs, independent of reconciling custom resources.

consoleLog.title: Console logs

enabled.description: Whether the operator logs to stdout.

level.title: Console log level
level.description: Verbosity of the console logs. A tracing filter directive, for example INFO, or something more targeted like info,stackable_secret_operator=debug.

format.title: Log format
format.description: plain is human-readable and coloured unless NO_COLOR is set. json is structured, for log collectors that parse it.

consoleLog.description: Logs written to stdout, which is what kubectl logs shows.

fileLog.title: File logs
fileLog.description: Writes logs to /stackable/logs inside the container.

enabled.description: Whether the operator also writes logs to /stackable/logs inside the container. Off by default: it needs a volume to be useful, otherwise the logs vanish with the pod.

level.title: File log level
level.description: Verbosity of the file logs, independent of the console log level. Same syntax.

rotationPeriod.title: Rotation period
rotationPeriod.description: How often a new log file is started.

maxFiles.title: Files to keep
maxFiles.description: How many rotated files to keep. Older ones are deleted.

otelLogExporter.title: OpenTelemetry log exporter
otelLogExporter.description: Exports operator logs to an OTLP collector.

otelTraceExporter.title: OpenTelemetry trace exporter
otelTraceExporter.description: Exports operator traces to an OTLP collector.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Values shared with parent and sibling charts when this chart is used as a subchart. Not read by this chart.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.description: A tracing filter directive, for example INFO, or something more specific like info,stackable_secret_operator=debug. Not a fixed set of values.

endpoint.title: OTLP endpoint
endpoint.description: Collector to send to. Defaults to the OpenTelemetry SDK default when unset.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Maximum CPU and memory the container may use.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: CPU and memory reserved for the container.
